enable_js.other: Enable JavaScript to submit these forms securely.

choose_section.other: Choose a permitted section from navigation.

no_sections.other: No administration sections are permitted for this account.

input_invalid.other: Check the input and try again.

session_expired.other: Your session expired or could not be verified. Sign in again.

record_missing.other: No matching record was found. Check the identifier before another change.

permission_denied.other: You do not have permission for this operation.

record_conflict.other: The record changed or conflicts with this request. Look it up before another change.

service_busy.other: The service is busy. Wait before trying again.

outcome_unknown.other: The outcome could not be confirmed. Do not repeat the change automatically. Inspect the account or image library before another change.

password_length.other: Check the password length in characters (at most 1024 UTF-8 bytes).

completed.other: Completed. Check the displayed result before another change.

login_missing.other: No account matched the exact login. Check the retained login before another creation attempt.

service_unavailable.other: The request could not be completed. Check the connection or contact the operator. Review the record before submitting a change again.

credentials_invalid.other: The login or password was not accepted. Check both and sign in again.

request_timeout.other: The request body did not arrive in time. This operation was not started; check the connection before submitting again.

request_canceled.other: The request was canceled before the operation started. Check the connection before another submission.

locale_unavailable.other: The selected interface language could not be loaded. Contact the operator or choose an installed language.

authorization_unavailable.other: Permission could not be checked. This is not an explicit denial. Contact the operator with the reference.

authentication_unavailable.other: The sign-in service could not verify the request. Contact the operator; do not repeatedly submit credentials.

permissions_unavailable.other: Completed. Action permissions could not be checked, so actions are disabled. Keep the displayed identifier and refresh the record before another change.

result_unavailable.other: The server acknowledged completion, but the response details could not be displayed. Do not repeat the change; inspect the record first.

input_id.other: Check the record identifier and submit the corrected value.

input_login.other: Check the login format and submit the corrected value.

input_password.other: Check the password length and submit a valid password.

input_revision.other: Refresh the record and use its current revision before another change.

input_enabled.other: Choose the requested account status before submitting.

read_result_unavailable.other: The read response could not be displayed. Check the connection and read the record again; no change was requested.

operation_not_started.other: The operation could not start. Check service availability with the operator before submitting again.
